StarNet v0.15.0 This update improves StarNet's reliability, privacy, security and spending controls. Jobs now wait for your decision when a reviewer blocks them, deleting a chat clears far more of what the station kept from it, images of unknown cost are capped, and save files are much smaller for stations with a lot of chat history. It also adds steering an agent mid-task from COMMS, a recovery bundle for backing up your station, and a station designer with seven new floor plans. Your station saves again Stations stop disappearing.
